item.tib: gsang sngags ma rgyud rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gar gyi lag len bde ba'i yan lag lha dbang rgyan gyi yid 'phrog
item.coloph: de ltar lag len rgyas dang 'bring dang bsdus pa gsum las gang 'dod skabs dang sbyar la blang ba'i rigs de'i lag len zhib par bya ba bla ma nyid kyi zhal la dris shing spyad na mkhas pa'i mchog tu gyur pa yin/ gsang ba'i mchog chen gsang sngags rgyal po'i bon/ gsang ba sngags pa'i lam gyis (gyi) khyad par las/ gsang ba'i yan lag rnam dbye gar gyi tshogs/ gsang ba'i bkod pa 'di dag khyad par 'phags/ ma rgyud gsang ba mkha' 'gro zhes bya ba gar gyi lag len lha dbang rgyan gyi yid 'phrog zhes bya ba/ dmu rigs nyi ma'i mtshan can gyis brtsams pa dge legs 'phel/ grub pa gshen gyi gnas mchog gter gyi gnas chen 'bring 'tshams mtha' dkar gshen gyi gzim khang du brtsams/ me byi zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gsum la dge legs so//

item.tib: gsang sngags ma rgyud rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gar gyi lag len bde ba'i yan lag lha dbang rgyan gyi yid 'phrog
item.coloph: ma rgyud gsang ba mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i/ gar gyi lag len lha dbang rgyan gyi yid 'phrog zhes bya ba/ dmu rigs nyi ma'i ming can gyis brtsams pa dge legs 'phel/ grub pa gshen gyi gnas mchog gter gyi gnas chen 'bring mtshams mtha' dkar gshen gyi gzim khang du brtsams pa'i me byi zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gsum la dge/
